reason: This is primarily an external service integration plugin that exposes Alibaba Cloud Drive capabilities through DeepSeek Harness tools and a web conversation tab, with user-facing workflows for cloud file management and transfer operations (including status and background task controls). The evidence shows concrete cloud-drive actions, service-specific CLI integration, and a dedicated UI surface, while risk is moderate due remote file manipulation and destructive-action controls.

summaries.zh: 该插件将阿里云盘 CLI 封装为 DeepSeek Harness 可调用工具，并提供会话界面标签页，用于浏览、上传、下载、同步及管理云端文件。
summaries.en: This plugin wraps the Alibaba Cloud Drive CLI into DeepSeek Harness tools and provides a conversation UI tab for browsing, uploading, downloading, syncing, and managing cloud files.

capabilities: Cloud drive account/session querying and drive switching
Cloud file listing, navigation, and basic file operations
File upload and download with concurrency/retry controls
Share link creation and album listing/download actions
Sync backup-like upload/download workflows with policy options
Web UI tab for invoking and viewing tool outputs
